fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the change set fixing leaked test temp folders (rhiza-api/index/slice-budget-*, rhiza-quiet-*) that filled the VM disk when go test timeouts skipped TestMain's cleanup. The planner asked which intent the change set serves and how to clean up; no owner answered, and the arbiter decided (assumed): it serves milestone-25, and each package sweeps its own prefix's folders older than an hour at start through one shared helper, tested with a stale and a fresh folder. No per-run directory deleted by make test. Nothing is left open.
fields.title: Test temp folder cleanup, autonomous plan interview
